Opposition mocks Piyush Goyal after US envoy's comment

A United States diplomatic envoy made a remark concerning Indian minister Piyush Goyal. Opposition leader K. K. Khera responded by mocking Goyal with the sarcastic phrase “From Vishwaguru to visa receptionist”. The phrase was quoted in coverage by multiple centrist Indian outlets. The reports did not provide the content of the US envoy's original remark. The incident was reported without additional context or follow‑up statements.
